comparisonControls: The same final probe source, signals, schedules, deterministic random seed, capacity calculation, and acceptance gates were used before and after.
RL_LEGACY_CLOCK only bypasses APIs unavailable in baseline: prepare_clock/buffer seeding and hardware timestamp factor observations; it calls the actual baseline prepare_ratio/read.
Initial zero-production reads before first production are priming, reported separately; late zero and partial production are failures.
Source signal time follows physical input clock; expected output tone time follows independently configured physical output clock. Arrival jitter does not alter hardware timestamp truth.

independentReview.result: No blocking arithmetic/lifetime issue found. Reviewed independent timestamp normalization, flag/reset/failure handling, process-idle exemption, Apple buffer maximum property semantics, ownership, and telemetry. Corrected two nonblocking findings: buffer control-panel guidance and re-preparation latch reset; focused assertion covers reset.

limitations: Generated schedules do not qualify physical device clocks, host load, real callback delivery, hardware sleep/hotplug, or long-session behavior.
This 440 Hz signal instrument does not establish full-band resampler response, perceptual transparency, bit-perfect conversion, or physical end-to-end latency.
The estimator corrects rate; it does not align absolute source sample time, phase, transport latency, or startup delay between unrelated capture selectors/devices.
Missing timestamp metadata falls back to bounded occupancy feedback. Indefinite missing metadata at coarse block sizes is not qualified by temporary metadata tests.
Strict timeline faults now stop audio; this is fail-closed detection, not a repair of missed hardware callbacks.
Installed run 40011635266 remains a strict failure with independent timestamp gaps and 296 underflow frames. No acceptance thresholds or source amplitudes in that installed test were changed.
Exploratory candidate CSVs retain observations but do not have complete source snapshots. Baseline and final comparison source hashes are exact.

Valid configuration spans 8–384 kHz, ratios 1:24 through 24:1 and callbacks at most 16,384 frames; practical latency can be very large at coarse blocks. No provisional duration cutoff was used to discard failed cases.
